Education is not merely the acquisition of knowledge; it is the building of character, the cultivation of values, and the empowerment of young minds to lead with integrity and purpose.

Dear Parents, Students, and Well-Wishers,

It gives me immense pride and joy to welcome you to Vishal Model Senior Secondary School, Dhuri.

At our institution, we believe every child is endowed with unique potential waiting to be discovered and nurtured. Our mission goes beyond textbooks and examinations—we strive to create an inclusive, disciplined, and stimulating environment where curiosity is encouraged, critical thinking is developed, and moral values are deeply rooted.

In an ever-evolving world, we equip our students with strong academic foundations, modern technological competence, and life skills necessary to face future challenges with confidence. Alongside scholastic rigor, we place significant emphasis on sports, cultural activities, and leadership development to ensure well-rounded growth.

We consider education a shared partnership between the school, parents, and the community. Together, we work tirelessly to guide our students toward becoming responsible citizens and compassionate global leaders.

I invite you to explore our vibrant campus community and partner with us on this rewarding journey of learning.

Warm regards,
Vishal Seth
Principal, Vishal Model Senior Secondary School, Dhuri

About the School

A campus built on discipline, care and steady results.

Vishal Model Senior Secondary School has grown from a single block on Bagrian Road into one of Dhuri's established PSEB institutions, carrying students from their first day in Nursery through to Class XII board examinations.

The school follows a curriculum that balances academic depth with co-curricular life — sport, music, debate and community service are treated as part of the timetable, not an afterthought. Class sizes are kept manageable so that teachers know each student by name.

Experienced Staff

Most senior faculty have taught at the school for over a decade.

Local Roots

A neighbourhood school that most families in Dhuri have known for a generation.

Academics

Four stages, one continuous track from first classroom to board results.

The academic programme is organised into four stages, each building the habits and subject grounding needed for the next.

Stage 01

Pre-Primary

Nursery to UKG. Play-based learning focused on language, motor skills and early number sense.

Stage 02

Primary

Classes I–V. Core literacy and numeracy, with introductory science, Punjabi, Hindi and English.

Stage 03

Middle & Secondary

Classes VI–X. Full PSEB curriculum with science labs, computer studies and Class X board preparation.

Stage 04

Senior Secondary

Classes XI–XII. Specialised streams with dedicated subject teachers for board and entrance exam readiness.

Streams offered at +2 level
Campus & Facilities

Everything a school day needs, on one campus.

Library

A quiet reading hall with a growing collection of reference texts, fiction and periodicals.

Science Labs

Separate physics, chemistry and biology laboratories equipped for PSEB practical requirements.

Computer Lab

Networked systems for IT classes from Class VI onward, with basic coding introduced early.

Sports Ground

An open ground for athletics, kabaddi, cricket and PT periods, with coaching for inter-school meets.

School Transport

Bus routes covering Dhuri and nearby villages, with an attendant on board for younger students.

Assembly Hall

A multipurpose hall for the morning assembly, annual function and indoor events.

Medical Room

A first-aid room with a trained attendant on duty through the school day.

Cafeteria

A canteen serving hygienic snacks and meals, overseen by school staff.

Admissions

How to apply

Admissions for the new session open in spring and continue on a rolling basis, subject to seats. Reach out using the query section below, or follow the steps here.

  • Get in touch

    Send us your child's details through the “Ask a Query” section — the admissions office will call you back within two working days.

  • Campus visit

    Visit the campus with previous report cards for an informal assessment and to meet the class teacher.

  • Confirm the seat

    Complete the admission form and fee payment to confirm the seat for your child's class.

+2 Stream

Commerce Stream

A practical, business-focused path into finance, management, and the wider world of trade — one of the most flexible streams for building a long-term career.

Scope

Where the Commerce stream can take you

Commerce gives students a working foundation in accounting, business, and economics from Class XI itself, which keeps doors open across both traditional and fast-growing fields. Beyond the well-known path into Chartered Accountancy, it now extends into banking, company law, digital marketing, data analytics, and entrepreneurship.

Strong Professional Routes

CA, CS, and CMA offer respected, high-earning careers with a clear step-by-step path.

Business & Management

B.Com, BBA, and later an MBA open doors into corporate management and leadership roles.

Emerging Digital Fields

Analytics, e-commerce, and digital marketing welcome commerce graduates with business sense.

Flexible Later On

Commerce students can still move into law, civil services, or general management.

Job Opportunities

Career paths Commerce students often pursue

Chartered Accountant (CA)

Handles auditing, taxation, and financial reporting for businesses.

Company Secretary (CS)

Advises companies on legal, statutory, and regulatory compliance.

Cost & Management Accountant

Focuses on budgeting, cost control, and efficient business spending.

Investment Banker / Financial Analyst

Works with markets and financial data to guide business decisions.

Business Manager / Entrepreneur

Leads teams and operations, or builds a business of their own.

Bank PO & Financial Services

Stable, structured careers through competitive entrance exams.

Digital Marketing / E-commerce

Applies business fundamentals to fast-growing online roles.

Corporate Lawyer / Tax Consultant

Specialises in corporate, tax, or business-related legal work.

+2 Stream

Humanities Stream

A people-focused path into law, media, psychology, public service, and the creative world — built around thinking, writing, and understanding people well.

Scope

Where the Humanities stream can take you

Humanities is often misunderstood as having limited career options, but it is actually one of the broadest streams available — covering law, education, media, psychology, design, public policy, and civil services. The skills it builds, like critical thinking and communication, are valued across almost every industry today.

Wide Career Range

From law and journalism to psychology and design, few streams open as many doors.

Civil Services & Public Life

A strong foundation for UPSC, state civil services, and public policy careers.

In-Demand Soft Skills

Communication, empathy, and critical thinking are increasingly sought after.

Room to Pivot

Humanities students can later move into management, law, or design.

Job Opportunities

Career paths Humanities students often pursue

Civil Services (IAS / IPS)

A common and strong foundation for UPSC and state civil service exams.

Lawyer / Legal Advisor

A natural next step for students interested in justice and advocacy.

Journalist / Mass Communication

Reporting and writing roles across print, TV, and digital media.

Psychologist / Counsellor

Helps individuals with mental health and behaviour.

Teacher / Academician

Shares subject knowledge at school or college level.

Social Worker / Public Policy

Works on community welfare, NGOs, or government policy.

Content Writer / Editor

Turns strong writing skills into a publishing or media career.

International Relations / Design

Careers in diplomacy, foreign languages, or creative design fields.
